profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CGI
profile.summary:
•	Twelve plus years of professional experience as a software developer
•	Provide professional technology consulting solutions to clients (Cigna, Edward Jones)
•	Software developer at the largest health insurance company in the world
•	Proficiency and experience in microservices, full stack & back end software development
•	Part of team that designed, developed, tested, and deployed WellAtHome’s platform for COVID-19 response

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, tested & deployed WellAtHome’s platform for COVID-19 crisis response

Contributed to successful rollout of suite of microservices catering to 200,000 users

Developed highly interactive single page application to document claims of 9,000 families with special needs

Integrated microservices into call center legacy application, creating a seamless experience for agents

Regularly shadowed call center agents to understand needs, designed solutions to address problems, laid out work for development team, and conveyed costs to leadership

Built a means of ingesting member data into enterprise content management system, making data accessible to other microservices

Managed releases across multiple teams, ensuring successful deployments without disrupting downstream consumers

positions.title: Computer Science Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
Iowa State University's undergraduate program is designed to train computer scientists, information technologists, and software engineers for productive, life-long careers. Students are equipped with a strong understanding of computer science fundamentals, problem solving, and system design skills for designing and building robust, efficient, reliable, scalable, and flexible software systems.

Responsibilities:
Hosted recitation and review sessions for over 200 students annually.
 
Facilitated office hours to assist students in their learning within the classroom. 

Graded all student programming projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Kingland Systems is known for developing enterprise-class software for the largest companies and governmental regulators in the world, helping them solve complex data problems and manage trillions of dollars of risk. Their software, and data, manages more than 25,000,000 records in over 150 countries and in 40 languages for clients in industries including audit and accounting, buy-side and sell-side financial institutions, custodial banks, commercial banks, insurance companies, regulators, and high tech companies.

Developed tools to substantially cut HR hiring process costs, reduce human error, and aid 500+ employees

Technologies: C#, ASP.NET, Razor, Javascript, LDAP, SQL, HTML, CSS

projects.title: Ignite Prototype
projects.description: Collaborated with a RAD (Rapid Application Development) Team in the R&D department of Unitedhealth Group ($130+ Billion in revenue company) to help solve health issues worldwide and reduce customer premium rates.

projects.title: Buy-Cycle
projects.description: HackISU is a 36 hour code jam, where my team built software for an on campus bicycle rental service that solved the current budget challenges facing Iowa State University.

organizations.name: Computer Science/Software Engineering Club
organizations.description:
Iowa State University's CSE Club is for the promotion and retention of computer scientists and software engineer's within the college's program.

* Revamped existing processes in an effort to boost retention rates.

* Attend meetings and provide other officers with feedback.

* Acting president during club president's absence.

organizations.name: HackISU
organizations.description:
Organized the largest hackathon in the state of Iowa; 300+ people

Coordinated with MIS club, responded to emails, attended meetings, & advised attendee’s projects
